incidents.name: Incident on 2012-01-27 15:52:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-01-27 15:52:00 - We're investigating errors on push. Data is still received, but our internal post-recive hook isn't firing.
  • 2012-01-27 16:18:00 - Pushes are working again. We're manually firing off hooks for all of those who saw an error on push.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-01-24 03:05:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-01-24 03:05:00 - Looks like we had a bad deployment go out. Should be fixed in a few minutes.
  • 2012-01-26 23:50:00 - We're investigating an issue with the load balancer.
  • 2012-01-27 00:08:00 - Load balancer issue is resolved. Services should be back to normal now.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-01-24 03:05:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2012-01-24 03:05:00 - Services should be back to normal now.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-01-19 18:03:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-01-19 18:03:00 - We're seeing some unicorns on the site. Investigating.
  • 2012-01-19 18:44:00 - Everything is back to normal. We nuked an expensive query from the homepage that DDOSed our DB servers when the cache expired.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-01-12 13:04:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-01-12 13:04:00 - High database load is causing a high rate of errors across the site. We're researching the issue.
  • 2012-01-12 13:10:00 - Everything's back to normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2012-01-03 16:43:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2012-01-03 16:43:00 - Pushing and fetching via HTTP is slow and/or times out with a 403 or 504 error. We're researching the issue. The operation often goes through on a retry. SSH and git protocol access are not effected.
  • 2012-01-03 17:18:00 - We're rolling out some changes to correct the git over http issues now. Hang tight.
  • 2012-01-03 17:19:00 - Git access over HTTP has been fully restored. A too-low haproxy maximum connections limit was responsible and has been increased significantly.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-12-26 13:25:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-12-26 13:25:00 - One of the storage servers is flapping, causing interruptions in access for a small percentage of repositories. We're investigating.
  • 2011-12-26 13:38:00 - All repository access restored.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-12-21 22:03:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-12-21 22:03:00 - High error rates on the site. We're investigating.
  • 2011-12-21 22:09:00 - And we're back. It looks like there was temporary network connectivity issues. We're looking into it.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-12-14 22:28:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-12-14 22:28:00 - We're performing emergency maintenance on one of our fileservers. It should be back soon!
  • 2011-12-14 22:50:00 - Fileserver maintenance is complete! Please contact support if you have any repos that still indicate that the storage server is offline.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-12-12 02:02:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-12-12 02:02:00 - We'll be performing scheduled maintenance tonight from 18:00 - 20:00 PST to double the RAM in our MySQL and Redis servers. HTTP and Git access to github.com will be down intermittently during this window, but we're not expecting any more than 30 minutes o
  • 2011-12-12 02:29:00 - We're restarting MySQL now. HTTP and Git access will be down for a few minutes.
  • 2011-12-12 02:59:00 - MySQL is back up. We're migrating Redis between servers in a few minutes.
  • 2011-12-12 03:12:00 - Maintenance is done! Please contact support if encounter any strange behavior on the site.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-12-09 05:57:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-12-09 05:57:00 - Repository access is down on one of the storage servers. Back momentarily.
  • 2011-12-09 06:54:00 - Repository access to the storage server has been restored.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-11-29 17:11:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-11-29 17:11:00 - One of the file servers is out of space. One of our sysadmins is looking into it now.
  • 2011-11-29 18:40:00 - The file server is back. It looks like autogc ate up a ton of disk space before we could respond to the original nagios alert in time.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-11-08 12:42:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-11-08 12:42:00 - Pages is down. We're working on it now, should be back up shortly!\r\n
  • 2011-11-08 13:57:00 - The pages server is back up! Please email support@github.com if you're having any trouble.
